name: HOAI 2021 — Architect and Engineer Fee Structure
description: Validates project fee documentation against the Honorarordnung fuer Architekten und Ingenieure (HOAI) 2021. Checks that service phases (Leistungsphasen LP1-LP9) are documented and ordered, Honorarzone (HZ I-V) is assigned, anrechenbare Kosten (chargeable construction costs per paragraph 4) are stated, and the fee calculation references the applicable Honorartafel.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
regulator: Bundesministerium fuer Wohnen, Stadtentwicklung und Bauwesen
